visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of hands moving white and green mahjong tiles on a green felt table. A young man wearing a beige and white sweater and glasses watches the game. The camera cuts to him smiling while holding a small brown cardboard box with text on it in a bright, white-walled indoor room. (2) Multiple players' hands are shown in a medium shot as they discard and rearrange tiles quickly. A man in a black t-shirt with text on it sits in the background, observing with a focused expression. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional studio or office environment. (3) The sequence continues with fast-paced editing, showing various angles of the mahjong gameplay. A person in a white t-shirt is seen handing out the same brown cardboard boxes to others standing around the tables. The background features more mahjong tables and stacks of boxes against the wall. (4) A man with thick white-framed glasses and a black t-shirt appears close to the camera, speaking animatedly. He then holds up a green phone case that has a printed photo of a smiling man on it. A young boy wearing glasses and a brown Minecraft-themed t-shirt is introduced to the table. (5) The young boy is now the focus, seated at the mahjong table. The man with white glasses stands over him, gesturing toward the tiles and guiding his play. A crowd of several young men stands in the background, watching the boy's progress under bright fluorescent lights. (6) The boy draws a specific tile, and his eyes widen behind his glasses. He raises his hands in triumph. The surrounding crowd reacts with visible excitement, some clapping and others leaning in. A woman in a black top moves in to give the boy a hug. (7) In the final phase, the man with white glasses laughs and shakes the boy's hand vigorously. The boy smiles modestly. They are standing in the same well-lit indoor space with the mahjong table and spectators still visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp, percussive clacking of hard objects (mahjong tiles) colliding repeatedly. A high-energy male voice speaks with rapid delivery and rising intonation. Upbeat electronic background music with a steady 4/4 beat starts immediately. (2) A loud 'click' of a tile being placed triggers a shift. Multiple voices enter the mix, creating a layer of laughter and cheerful chatter. The primary male voice maintains a high arousal level, with frequent pitch fluctuations. (3) Sharp rhythmic impact sounds continue as the main speaker gives instructions. The BGM remains consistent in the background. Short 'whoosh' transition effects are used between vocal segments. The spectral brightness is high due to the sharp transients of the tiles. (4) A sudden swell in volume occurs as a crowd of people erupts into a high-pitched cheer and loud applause. The vocal intensity reaches its peak here. The BGM continues to drive the rhythm under the layer of excitement. (5) The final phase features a more conversational but still very positive tone from the main male speaker, followed by another burst of collective cheering. The percussive tile sounds fade out as the track ends with a final enthusiastic shout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a fun and energetic social gathering focused on a mahjong game. The core appeal lies in the surprising skill of a young child playing against adults and the infectious excitement of the crowd when he wins. It serves as entertaining short-form content designed for social media engagement.
